Led by seventh-year head coach [[Jim Larrañaga]], they played their home games at the [[Watsco Center]] on the university's campus in [[Coral Gables, Florida]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). They finished the season 22–10, 11–7 in ACC play to finish in a four-way tie for third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to [[2017–18 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2017–18 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team|Loyola–Chicago]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Hurricanes]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 21–12, 10–8 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a three-way tie for seventh place. They defeated [[2016–17 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] in the second round of the [[2017 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2016–17 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the #8 seed in the Midwest region where they lost in the first round to #9 [[2016–17
